data.narrative:
Atmo is a Series A-stage AI & Software company founded by Alex Levy and Johan Mathe that has raised $29.1M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 9 private and 1 public company in the AI & Software sector, with key peers including Reflection AI ($25.0B Series A), Physical Intelligence ($5.6B Series B), Black Forest Labs ($3.2B Series B), and Field AI ($2.0B Series B).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression methodology, using total capital raised as a proxy for Series A value, applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier to the $29M base, yielding $58M. The peer-median approach across four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables produces a median valuation of $4.4B, with a range spanning $2.0B to $25.0B. The wide peer dispersion reflects heterogeneity within frontier AI, where valuation outcomes correlate strongly with differentiation and capital efficiency metrics not present in this dataset.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $49M (low) to $5.1B (high), with a median of $2.2B. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty around Atmo's product-market fit, competitive positioning, and capital efficiency relative to the peer set. Stage-progression alone suggests floor-level valuation; peer median dominates the conclusion. Critical unknowns include Atmo's revenue traction, unit economics, and technical differentiation versus the sampled AI companies.
